Summary / Title: Unable to Edit Email Address in Content Expert Profile
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
1. Click on the profile icon and select My Profile.
2. Verify that the CE can view basic information and that all information is loaded correctly.
3. Attempt to edit the Full Name and Email Address fields, then click Save Changes.
Expected Result: Email address should also be editable.
Actual Result: The Full Name can be updated successfully, but the Email Address field is not editable, and displays an error message "Something went wrong"

Summary / Title: Start Test Button Disabled After Clicking “Attempt Test” in Competency Evaluator
Description / Steps to Reproduce:
1. Go to IGCSE
2. Click on Testpaper
3. Select Competency Evaluator
4. Click on any chapter (e.g.,IGCSE- A.Maths Chapter 2 – Quadratic Functions)
5. Click on Attempt Test
6. Observe the Start Test button
Expected Result: The Start Test button should be enabled and allow the user to begin the test.
Actual Result: The Start Test button is disabled and cannot be clicked.
